item.title: House Speaker Pro Tem Jan Jones to retire after nearly two decades as legislative leader
item.description: A fixture in the leadership of Georgia’s House of Representatives will step down when her term ends this year, declining to run for re-election after nearly a quarter century in office. item.title: Augusta developer suing the City of Aiken for $40 million
